Officer's narrative
On the afternoon of the collision in Katy, Texas, Driver 2 was traveling straight through the intersection when Driver 1,
turning left across the oncoming lane, struck the front driver side of Driver 2's vehicle. Driver 1 presented documents
showing they are named on the policy covering the vehicle they were operating. Driver 1 reported a wrist fracture and
was transported for treatment. The reported injury is consistent with the mechanism of this impact. The damage to
both vehicles matches the described collision sequence. Scene photographs confirm the general positions of the
vehicles and the location of debris, though some detail was limited by the lighting. Driver 2, Driver 1, and the
Passenger each confirmed that the Passenger was seated in the vehicle at the time of impact, and I observed the
Passenger at the scene. No independent witnesses were identified. Several minor scratches on Driver 2's vehicle
appear weathered and may predate this crash, and I have noted them separately for the file.
